facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that the Benin-Togo roaming agreement took effect on 1 January 2024, and Benin, Senegal and Togo launched roaming among themselves in April 2026.
Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that Mali reached roaming agreements with Benin and Togo in December 2023.
